login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Use the passkey on this device, your phone or a security key.
login.noAccount: There is no sign-up form here: you join when a member invites you in person.

enroll.title: Set up your passkey
enroll.invalid: This link does not work any more. Ask for a new one.
enroll.genesisIntro: You are one of the first members. Create a passkey to finish setting up your account.
enroll.recoveryIntro: Your account is being recovered. Create a new passkey on this device.
enroll.tos: I accept the terms of service (version {version, number}).
enroll.readTerms: Read the terms of service (opens in a new tab)
enroll.age: I am at least {age, number} years old.
enroll.removeOld: Remove the old passkeys (recommended if a device was lost or stolen)

second.title: Add a second passkey?
second.body: A passkey on a second device, like your phone or a security key, keeps you from being locked out if this one is lost.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Passkeys are how you sign in. Adding or removing one asks you to confirm with a passkey first, and your acquaintances are told that your sign-in keys changed.
passkeys.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Every session started with it will be signed out.
passkeys.lastHint: You cannot remove your only passkey. Add another one first.
passkeys.addHint: Use a different device or security key than the ones you already have.

passkey.cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.
passkey.exists: This device already holds a passkey for your account. Use another device or security key.
passkey.unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Try an up-to-date browser.
passkey.failed: The passkey did not work. Try again.

errors.last_passkey: You cannot remove your only passkey.
errors.passkey_rejected: That passkey does not belong to this account, or the check failed. Try again.
errors.passkey_name_invalid: Use a shorter name without special characters.
errors.tos_required: Accept the terms of service to continue.

cosign.addSummary: Add the passkey “{name}” to your account, signed with a passkey you already have
cosign.removeSummary: Remove the passkey “{name}” from your account
